text: Transportation Services recommends that the portions of highway lands abutting Dundas Street West and Kipling Avenue be permanently closed and operational management of the lands to be transferred to Corporate Real Estate Management in order to complete the City-initiated Six Points Redevelopment Project.

City Council on February 2, 3 and 5, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the permanent closure of the portions of the public highway lands abutting Dundas Street West and Kipling Avenue, shown as Part 11 and 12 of the R-Plan 66R-30391 (the "Highway"), Attachment 2 to the report (December 14, 2020) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, Transportation Services. 2. City Council enact a by-law substantially in the form of the draft by-law attached as Appendix A to Attachment 1 to the report (December 14, 2020) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, Transportation Services.
